title: Columbia annual snapshot totals and field reconciliation, 2021–2024
description: One row per publication year in the Columbia University I78577930 lineage snapshot. Independently counted distinct work IDs across all work types, assigned and unassigned totals from the annual field artifact, and the difference (snapshot minus assigned minus unassigned).
code:
fields = load('T1')
base = sql('''SELECT publication_year, count(DISTINCT work_id) AS snapshot_work_count FROM works WHERE publication_year BETWEEN 2021 AND 2024 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1''')
assert len(fields) == 108 and not fields.duplicated(['publication_year','field_id']).any() and (fields.groupby('publication_year').size() == 27).all()
assigned = fields.loc[~fields.is_unassigned].groupby('publication_year', as_index=False).work_count.sum().rename(columns={'work_count':'assigned_work_count'})
unassigned = fields.loc[fields.is_unassigned,['publication_year','work_count']].rename(columns={'work_count':'unassigned_work_count'})
annual = base.merge(assigned,on='publication_year',validate='one_to_one').merge(unassigned,on='publication_year',validate='one_to_one')
annual['reconciliation_difference'] = annual.snapshot_work_count - annual.assigned_work_count - annual.unassigned_work_count
assert len(annual)==4 and (annual.reconciliation_difference==0).all()
print(annual.to_string(index=False))
print(fields.loc[fields.work_count==0].to_string(index=False))
print(save_table(annual, 'Columbia annual snapshot totals and field reconciliation, 2021–2024', 'One row per publication year in the Columbia University I78577930 lineage snapshot. Independently counted distinct work IDs across all work types, assigned and unassigned totals from the annual field artifact, and the difference (snapshot minus assigned minus unassigned).'))
